title: THE ARGUMENT MAP
subtitle: Why Taiwan's chip dominance is a deterrence asset, not just an economic fact.
source: TSMC Annual Report 2024; Chipwar (Miller 2022); CSIS Taiwan Strait Analysis

data.text: Taiwan's TSMC produces 92% of the world's most advanced chips.

claim.text: Taiwan holds extraordinary strategic deterrence value.

warrant.text: Control over critical chokepoints grants strategic leverage.

backing.text: Historical precedent — Suez Canal, Panama Canal, Strait of Hormuz.

qualifier.text: As long as no fab alternative emerges.

rebuttal.text: Semiconductor autarky succeeds in the US or EU.
